about_the_game:
Attention! This route is currently in active development. At present, it has been built from Dnipro to Zaporizhzhia (130 km). In future updates, the entire section to Henichesk (342 km) will be gradually completed, with more objects, detailing, and optimization added. The current price is preliminary and will increase after the main stages are completed. All updates will be free for owners of this route.

Route: Dnipro — Henichesk

This DLC adds a new electrified railway route to ZDSimulator, stretching over 342 km through southern Ukraine — from the major transport hub of Dnipro to the seaside town of Henichesk on the shores of the Sea of Azov.

The route is electrified with 3 kV DC and features both double-track and single-track sections. The mainline from Dnipro to Novooleksiivka is double-track, enabling dense traffic in both directions, while the segment from Novooleksiivka to Henichesk is single-track, requiring more precise train operations and dispatching.

Major stations along the route:

  • Dnipro-Holovnyi

  • Zaporizhzhia-1

  • Melitopol

  • Novooleksiivka

  • Henichesk

All infrastructure elements are carefully recreated: platforms, switches, working signals, speed limits, braking test points (PTO), bridges, level crossings, depots, sidings, and typical industrial and rural surroundings. The scenery includes rivers, steppe landscapes, and urban areas — all contributing to a realistic driving experience.

The route supports both passenger and freight operations and is compatible with all DC electric locomotives available in the game. You can drive manually or with ALS signaling. Custom scenario creation is also supported.

This route offers a balance of high-speed stretches, station-intensive zones, and complex single-track sections, making it suitable for both new players and experienced drivers looking for realism and variety.
